summary:
Partial B02 Construction inside the 23-path grant. The same 13 paths are changed or new. This is not accepted output and qualifies nothing.

Done:
(1)(3) The B01 openGovernedContextEndpoint is gone. reserveGovernedContextEndpoint reserves inert coordinates (endpoint, client path, Node path) before transport identity, and every request refuses with endpoint_inactive. bind() accepts only an open module-owned lookup whose occurrence matches the actual run, CCall and actor invocation. activate() runs only from the native onProcessStarted event. close() runs on absolute-timeout interruption, before artifact admission and in finally.
(2) The ActorProcessInvocationInput.governedContext member is removed, so no caller can inject a lookup. For a native Construction occurrence, actor_process calls selectOwnedGovernedContext with constructor role evidence from projectRunEnvironmentRoleEvidenceAtPrefix over the authenticated basis. If a selection is returned, it constructs the lookup after intent admission from the actual actorInvocationRef.
(9) Every exchange, served or refused, is retained with complete request and response bytes and their digests. Correspondence now requires one Bash tool_use whose command exactly equals governedContextCommand (executable, client, all four fields), exact wire bytes, and a single exact tool_result. Substituted commands, changed fields, non-Bash tools, stray calls, and missing, truncated, altered or errored evidence all refuse. Before admission, a durable transcript is written beside the raw stdout artifact. coldVerifyGovernedContext rejoins it from the admitted stdout digest, the occurrence and the binding, and reacquires owner state when a live lookup is supplied.
(10) Both HOW owners and release-claim.md are amended to state this truthfully.
(11) The embedded witness decodes to 4616 bytes with sha256 bee000fc…87b6, byte-equal to the retained file and containing ENOENT. The length/digest-gated complete:true repair is kept.
(12) This worktree has no node_modules or build/, and installing or building is outside the grant. I typechecked all 290 sources in memory with the lock-matching TypeScript 5.9.2 (valibot 1.4.2, @types/node 24.3.0 from the main checkout, read-only), unfiltered: DIAGNOSTICS=0, EXIT=0. An injected error was detected, so the check is not vacuous.
Tests ran under an in-memory transpiling loader, which wrote nothing:
- t287-governed-context: 10 tests, 9 pass, 0 fail, 1 skip (the fixed-client spawn test, because the client is not built). The adapter test reached the installed GC03.
- t287-default-library, name pattern "selector planning": 1 pass (the A short-stream repair), 1 fail with ENOENT reading build/code/src/abg/instruction_assembly.js through vm (harness limit), 1 skip (ABI5_PLANNING_PROJECTION_CAPTURE unset).

Writes outside the grant: none to the worksite. The tests created and removed their own socket and scratch directories under the OS temp directory.
gaps: Missing ingress, returned to Root (items 4-7): current owner contracts cannot express the GC03 selection, so selectOwnedGovernedContext always returns governed_context_not_selected and production never reserves an endpoint. GOVERNED_CONTEXT_MISSING_INGRESS names each gap: (a) the strict RUN_ENVIRONMENT_SCHEMA roles[] (frameRefs, policy, sourceBindings, accessRefs, contextPolicy) has no field for one private GC03 policy reference to a verified Context member; (b) GC03 is not a declared dependency inventory of the admitted Program; (c) no GC03 principal or source grant exists for the Construction actor; (d) the only owner Python permission is RunEnvironment.corpusAccess for axiom_indexer validate/project, so there is no lawful GC03 adapter execution permission; (e) no Construction work-order selector names a same-Run Testing Result and field. The Public schema was not extended and no authority was forged.

Item 4 not implemented: governance work-state recovery from the wrapper Construction execution basis and parent CCall, the finite task/rubric/Testing keys, and the producer/Result/field join with byteLength/digest validation are not derived from the real store. The selected-branch authorityFor relation has no production producer.

Item 8 incomplete: pinnedGc03HostReader drives the adapter's reacquire, resolve_artifact and query_artifacts callbacks, but no production owner supplies live callbacks, because nothing is ever selected.

Item 13 not authored: there is no model-free integration test of the real HoG CCall lifecycle → prepared leaf owner → actor process from a real held store and an admitted same-Run C2 Result. With the missing ingress, the real path cannot create a lookup without injection.

Item 12 incomplete: npm run build, generate-product-manifest, r1-packed-artifact, installed-language-smoke and the other affected C2 tests did not run, because there is no node_modules or build/ and installing is prohibited. Packaged client/adapter identity, the no-fallback package check and the fixed-client spawn test are unverified. The sibling selector-planning test failed only because it reads build files from disk.

The durable transcript digest is not bound in an admitted event (that would change the event payload schema). Cold rejoin anchors on the admitted stdout artifact digest plus self-certifying response bytes.

Correspondence is strict: any unclaimed tool_use that names the client, its environment variables or the endpoint (including a locally refused client call) refuses the Result. The prompt does not yet tell the actor the exact command form.
B4 native installed RC3 delivery remains a future Root-controlled witness. A02 stays blocked and UAT indeterminate. No Testing, UAT or qualification is claimed.
